parameters.prompt: The exact brown bear warrior in the reference performs ONE heavy ground stomp in place. From the resting pose it slowly lifts the front leg high with the knee bent and spreads the arm for balance, then slams the foot down hard, the whole body dropping into a low wide stance, holds the low impact pose briefly, then straightens and calmly returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. Keep the exact strict side profile facing LEFT from the reference: head, muzzle, chest and feet point to the left edge, the face never turns toward the camera. Keep the same bear head, rounded ears, brown fur, shoulder armor, bracer, round belt buckle and leather kilt, same proportions. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two arms and two legs. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole body stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. No turning toward the camera, jumping, punch, extra limbs, weapon, glow, energy, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: first second and a half lift the leg, a sudden stomp around two seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
